sloka: इति स्म दधिरे सर्वे मानाम्सि हरिपुङ्गवाः ।ततो रामो महातेजाः सुग्रीव मिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-२४-२२॥।।
transliteration: iti sma dadhire sarve mānāmsi haripuṅgavāḥ ।tato rāmo mahātejāḥ sugrīva midamabravīt ॥6-24-22॥।।

translations.english: Having heard Sugriva, there after splendid Rama spoke thus. "The army is divided (placed in position). Suka may be relieved."
